channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: ‘It was intense’: 75-year-old is the oldest person to finish the Arrowhead Ultra 135 on foot
item.description: Michael Koppy endured subzero cold, sleep deprivation and a calorie-costing mistake to complete the northern Minnesota ultramarathon in just under 60 hours.

item.title: The latest: Minnesota’s Winter Olympians begin competition Thursday in Italy
item.description: There are 59 athletes at the 2026 Milan Cortina Games with connections to Minnesota. Curlers and women’s hockey players are first up.

item.title: ‘It creates belief’: Gophers upset No. 10 Michigan State 76-73 for third win over ranked foe
item.description: The Gophers held off a late Spartans rally Wednesday night, Feb. 4, at Williams Arena for their first win over a top-10 opponent since 2021.

item.title: Kendall Qualls hopes anti-DEI message will push him over the top in governor’s race
item.description: The Republican businessman has relentlessly promoted his views since his last run for governor in 2022.

item.title: Ramstad: An economic bomb has hit Lake Street
item.description: Hispanic businesses are being hit hardest as customers and employees hide from federal agents — or leave Minnesota.

item.title: Government appeals temporary restraining order prohibiting the detention of Minnesota refugees
item.description: The federal government is reviewing the applications of thousands of Minnesota refugees.

item.title: The latest: Timberwolves in Giannis Antetokounmpo sweepstakes as trade deadline nears
item.description: Antetokounmpo has been an NBA champion and MVP with the Milwaukee Bucks, who might move him by the Thursday 2 p.m. trade deadline.

item.title: Federal lawyer tells judge ‘job sucks’ amid overload of immigration cases, court violations
item.description: U.S. District Judge Jerry Blackwell ordered the hearing for U.S. lawyers to explain the federal government’s failure to comply with court orders.

item.title: The latest: Local leaders demand faster ICE withdrawal from Minnesota
item.description: The White House border czar said 700 agents are leaving Minnesota amid negotiations with local officials on a deal for county jails to cooperate with federal immigration officials.

item.title: Sheriffs in two biggest metro counties mum on whether they’ll agree to ICE deal to end surge
item.description: Border czar Tom Homan wants more access to county jails to make it easier for ICE to detain immigrants being held there.
